note: The unknown masses the physics bench sets out (pluggybot issue #227),
in kilograms, IN ROTATION ORDER -- economy/questions.json's pattern: a
bank, drawn from on the task board's own sequence number so a deployed
robot works through it and a fresh board draws the same mass every
time. Nothing random. $PLUGGY_MASSES points a deploy at another file.
Every entry is at most challenge/bench.py's MAX_KG (0.40, what the claw
holds -- measured) and is NOT within TOLERANCE (10 %) of the known cube's
0.100 kg: an entry that close would pay 'it weighs what the other one
weighs'. Both are refused at load.
The value NEVER LEAVES THE SIM: it goes into the world's body_mass and
into Task.secret, which the stream and the overseer's context have no
path to. The offer says only that one cube's mass is unknown.
Not hashed into the build identity (evaluation/record.py): a different
bank changes what is on the floor, not what the robot is told, offered
